    Language: 
    Topics: ai, automation, description, generator, llm, n8n, upload, video, workflow, youtube

    README:
    Please credit Mohammad Ahsan Hummayoun when using, sharing, or adapting this workflow This n8n workflow streamlines the process of generating and publishing YouTube video descriptions. It solves the problem of manually writing unique and engaging descriptions for every new video, saving creators time and ensuring consistency. Upon detecting a new video upload, this automation fetches the video's details (like title and tags). These details are then passed to a Large Language Model (LLM), which intelligently crafts a relevant and optimized description. Finally, the workflow automatically publishes this new description to your YouTube video. This ensures your videos are always well-described and optimized for discoverability from the moment they go live. ⚙️ How it Works Trigger on New Upload The workflow is initiated when a new video is uploaded to your YouTube channel (likely via an RSS Feed Trigger or a YouTube Watch node). Fetch Video Details It retrieves essential information about the newly uploaded video, such as its title, existing tags, and any other relevant metadata. LLM Integration The fetched video details are sent to an LLM (e.g., via a Groq Cloud or OpenAI Chat node). The LLM processes this information to generate a comprehensive and keyword-rich video description. Update YouTube Video The generated description is then used to update the corresponding video on YouTube via a "YouTube Update Video" node. Notifications & Error Handling The workflow also includes steps for sending messages (e.g., via Gmail) to confirm successful operation or alert you of any errors, ensuring you're always informed. 🚀 Setup and Requirements YouTube Credentials An n8n credential for YouTube, allowing the workflow to access video details and update descriptions. LLM API Key A credential for your chosen Large Language Model provider (e.g., GROQAPIKEY for Groq Cloud, or OPENAIAPIKEY for OpenAI). Email Credentials (Optional) If you're using the notification feature, an n8n credential for your email service (e.g., Gmail SMTP). These API keys and credentials will be configured directly within their respective n8n nodes.

content:
Repository: kumarsamarth2001-bot/Youtube-automation-
    Description: Automated YouTube Shorts generator that creates vertical videos with text and synthetic voice using free tools. Runs daily through GitHub Actions and can be configured for YouTube uploads. Designed for a free, beginner-friendly workflow.
    Language: Python
    Topics: 

    README:
    Auto YouTube Shorts (free-first starter) This repository is a ready-to-run starter for generating a simple vertical Short using free/open-source tools, then optionally uploading it to YouTube. What it does - Runs manually or on a daily GitHub Actions schedule. - Creates a vertical 1080x1920 image video with narration. - Uses a small set of sample facts (replace these with reviewed original scripts). - Saves the MP4 as a downloadable GitHub Actions artifact. - Optional YouTube upload is included, but requires YouTube API OAuth credentials. Important limitations - This starter does not clone your voice. Free voice cloning is not reliably available as a hosted daily service. Use only a voice you own or have permission to use, and check the model licence and provider age rules. - It does not use Claude API or another paid AI API. Sample scripts are built in. You can later add a free-tier model if its terms and limits fit. - Automatic upload needs Google Cloud / YouTube Data API setup and a valid OAuth refresh token. The first run should be private/unlisted for testing. - GitHub Actions free usage and artifact limits apply. Public repositories can expose code, so never commit keys, tokens, private audio, or credentials. - Automated publishing can fail due to API quota, OAuth expiry/revocation, or YouTube project verification restrictions. Android setup 1. Download and unzip this project. 2. Open GitHub in Chrome and create/open your repository. 3. Upload all files and folders from this project. GitHub's web interface may require uploading files individually or using the GitHub mobile app; alternatively upload the ZIP contents from a computer. 4. In the repository, open Actions and enable workflows if prompted. 5. Open Daily Shorts, choose Run workflow, and start a test. 6. When complete, open the workflow run and download the daily-short artifact. Optional YouTube upload 1. In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable YouTube Data API v3. 2. Configure OAuth consent and create OAuth client credentials. 3. Use the Google OAuth flow to obtain a refresh token with the YouTube upload scope: 4. Create a compact JSON token file with the authorized user's clientid, clientsecret, refreshtoken, and tokenuri ( Do not share this file. 5. In GitHub repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions, add a secret named YOUTUBEOAUTHJSON containing the entire JSON file contents. 6. Add a repository variable YOUTUBEUPLOADENABLED with value true only after private/unlisted testing. 7. Default upload privacy is private. To change it, edit src/uploadyoutube.py only after testing. YouTube may restrict public uploads for unverified API projects. Follow current Google requirements. Files - src/main.py: creates video. - src/uploadyoutube.py: optional uploader. - .github/workflows/daily-shorts.yml: daily schedule (09:00 IST approx). - requirements.txt: Python dependencies.

content:
Repository: muratcihanyandi/AutoShorts-Studio
    Description: AI-powered short video generator & streamer clips automation studio (YouTube, Twitch, Kick).
    Language: Python
    Topics: 

    README:
    AutoShorts Studio 🎬⚡ AutoShorts Studio, yapay zeka destekli video üretimi ve yayıncı yayınlarından (YouTube, Twitch, Kick) tam otomatik Shorts, Reels ve TikTok klipleri oluşturan hepsi-bir-arada, kurumsal standartta açık kaynaklı video stüdyosudur. English Documentation | Türkçe Dokümantasyon --- 📌 İçindekiler - Genel Bakış ve Vizyon - Çift Motor Mimarisi - 1. Sıfırdan AI Video Üretici (AI Video Generator) - 2. Yayıncı Klip & Shorts Otopilotu (Streamer Clips Engine) - Arayüzler ve Kullanım Modları - WebUI (Görsel Arayüz) - REST API (Geliştirici Arayüzü) - CLI (Komut Satırı) - Kurulum Rehberi - Yapılandırma (config.toml) - YouTube Otomatik Yayıncı Kurulumu - Docker ile Dağıtım - Proje Dosya Yapısı - Lisans --- 💡 Genel Bakış ve Vizyon Sosyal medya platformlarında (YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok) organik büyümenin anahtarı düzenli, yüksek kaliteli ve ilgi çekici video akışıdır. AutoShorts Studio, iki temel içerik üretim ihtiyacını tek çatı altında toplar: 1. Sıfırdan Bilgi & Eğlence Videoları: Sadece bir konu veya anahtar kelime girerek metin yazarlığı, görsel eşleştirme, seslendirme, altyazı ve fon müziği adımlarını otonom yönetir. 2. Yayıncı Kesitleri (Clips): YouTube, Twitch ve Kick yayınlarını arka planda tarar, en yüksek tempolu / kahkahalı / aksiyon dolu (hype) anları ses analiziyle yakalar, jenerikleri kırpar, dikey 9:16 formata odaklar, kelime kelime altyazılandırır ve doğrudan YouTube kanalınıza zamanlanmış olarak yükler. --- ⚙️ Çift Motor Mimarisi mermaid flowchart TD subgraph Engine1["Motor 1: Sıfırdan AI Video Üretimi"] A[Konu / Fikir / Prompt] --> B[LLM Senaryo & Terim Üretimi] B --> C[Stok Video / Görsel Arama - Pexels/Pixabay] B --> D[TTS Doğal Seslendirme] D --> E[Faster-Whisper Kelime Zamanlaması] C & D & E --> F[Dinamik BGM Ducking & Animasyonlu Altyazı] F --> G[Render: 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 HD Video] end subgraph Engine2["Motor 2: Yayıncı Klip & Shorts Otopilotu"] H[Yayın Takibi: YouTube / Twitch / Kick] --> I{Filtreleme} I -->|Tazelik: Son 7 Gün| J[FFmpeg ebur128 Hype Analizi] I -->|Kara Liste: Açıklama, Duyuru| X[Otomatik Eleme] J --> K[Intro / Outro Akıllı Kırpma] K --> L[9:16 Dikey Akıllı Kadraj] L --> M[Faster-Whisper Karaoke Altyazı] M --> N[YouTube Shorts Otomatik Yükleyici] end --- 1. Sıfırdan AI Video Üretici (AI Video Generator) Geniş LLM Desteği: OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini), Google Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek (V3 & R1), Anthropic Claude, Moonshot Kimi, xAI Grok ve yerel modeller için yerel Ollama desteği. Akıllı Stok Medya Eşleştirme: Pexels ve Pixabay API'leri ile senaryonun her cümlesine en uygun 1080p / 4K videoları otomatik arar, indirir ve sürelerini sahne temposuna göre keser. İsteğe bağlı yerel video/resim klasörlerinizi kullanabilir. TwelveLabs Çok Modlu Video Anlama: İsteğe bağlı TwelveLabs Marengo modeliyle indirilen videoların semantik içeriğini analiz ederek konuya en yüksek alaka düzeyine sahip sahneleri önceliklendirir. Üst Düzey Seslendirme (TTS): - Microsoft Edge-TTS: Ücretsiz, sınırsız, API anahtarı gerektirmeyen yüzlerce doğal dil ve aksan. - Kokoro TTS: Yeni nesil ultra hızlı ve insan doğallığında açık kaynaklı yerel ses sentezi. - ElevenLabs: Profesyonel stüdyo kalitesinde duygulu ve klonlanmış sesler. - Azure Speech & OpenAI Audio: Kurumsal Microsoft ve OpenAI Alloy/Echo/Nova sesleri. Kelime Bazlı Animasyonlu Altyazılar (Karaoke): Faster-Whisper motoru konuşmadaki her kelimenin başlangıç ve bitiş milisaniyesini çıkarır. TikTok ve Reels standartlarında kelime kelime parlayan, zıplayan karaoke altyazıları oluşturur. Yazı tipi, boyutu, kenar çizgisi (stroke), gölge ve arka plan kutucukları tamamen özelleştirilebilir. Akıllı Arka Plan Müziği (Audio Ducking): Telifsiz müzik kütüphanesinden otomatik seçim yapar. Konuşmacı konuşurken müziğin sesini otomatik kısar (ducking), konuşma durduğunda müziği yükseltir. --- 2. Yayıncı Klip & Shorts Otopilotu (Streamer Clips Engine) Çoklu Platform Canlı ve VOD Keşfi: Takip ettiğiniz yayıncıların YouTube, Twitch veya Kick kanallarını düzenli periyotlarla tarar. Tazelik ve Viralite Filtresi: - Tazelik Eşiği: Varsayılan son 7 gün içindeki videolar incelenir (eski ve bayat içerikler elenir). - Viralite Eşiği: 7 günden eski videolar elenirken, belirlenen izlenme eşiğini (örneğin 50.000+) aşmış ekstrem viral anlar yakalanır. Başlık Kara Listesi (Blacklist): "Açıklama", "duyuru", "sorun yaşıyorum", "bilgilendirme" gibi oyun dışı veya sıkıcı konuşma videoları otomatik olarak filtrelenir. FFmpeg ebur128 Hype Enerji Analizi: Saatler süren yayınları tek tek izlemenize gerek kalmaz. FFmpeg'in entegre ses şiddeti algoritması, yayıncının kahkaha attığı, bağırdığı, chat'in coştuğu tepe enerji (hype) anlarını matematiksel tepe noktalarıyla milisaniye hassasiyetinde tespit eder. Intro & Outro Temizleyici: - Sabit kırpma süreleriyle yayın başlangıç ekranı (örneğin ilk 5 sn) ve bitiş jeneriği (örneğin son 6 sn) kesilir. - Dinamik siyah ekran (blackdetect) ve sessizlik (silencedetect) algoritmalarıyla boşta kalan donuk kareler otomatik temizlenir. 9:16 Dikey Akıllı Kadraj: 16:9 yatay yayın görüntüsünü dinamik bulanık arka plan ve odaklanmış dikey format ile Shorts/Reels/TikTok standardına çevirir. Otomatik Whisper Transkripsiyon: Klipteki konuşmaları Faster-Whisper ile yazıya dökerek animasyonlu renkli altyazılar ekler. YouTube Shorts Otomatik Yükleme: Günlük kota koruması (örneğin günde maksimum 5 video), otomatik SEO uyumlu başlık, açıklama ve etiketlerle YouTube kanalınıza doğrudan video yükler. --- 🖥️ Arayüzler ve Kullanım Modları 1. WebUI (Streamlit) Kullanıcı dostu, modern koyu tema grafik arayüz. AI Video Oluşturucu Tabı: Konu girin, ses ve format seçin, tek tıkla videoyu render edin ve önizleyin. Klip Otomasyon Tabı: Takip edilen kanalları yönetin, ses eşiklerini, kırpma sürelerini ve YouTube kota limitlerini ayarlayın; arka plan taramasını tek tıkla başlatın. 2. REST API (FastAPI) Harici yazılımlar, botlar veya web servisleri ile entegrasyon için yüksek performanslı REST API: POST /api/v1/videos: Yeni bir video oluşturma görevi başlatır. GET /api/v1/tasks/{taskid}: Görevin ilerleme yüzdesini ve durumunu sorgular. POST /api/v1/clips/discover: Yayıncı kanallarından klip keşfini tetikler. POST /api/v1/clips/{clipid}/render: Seçilen klibi dikey Shorts formatına render eder. POST /api/v1/clips/{clipid}/publish: Klibi doğrudan YouTube Shorts'a yükler. Swagger Dokümantasyonu: adresinden interaktif olarak test edilebilir. 3. CLI (Otomasyonu) Arayüz açmadan terminal veya betik üzerinden video üretimi: bash python AutoShortsStudio/cli.py --video-subject "Yapay Zeka Dünyayı Nasıl Değiştiriyor?" --video-aspect 9:16 --- 🚀 Kurulum Rehberi Gereksinimler - İşletim Sistemi: Windows 10/11, macOS veya Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+ önerilir) - Python: 3.11 veya üzeri - FFmpeg: Sistem yolunda (PATH) veya lib/ffmpeg/ altında kurulu olmalıdır. 1. Windows Taşınabilir Başlangıç (En Kolay Yol) 1. Repoyu klonlayın veya indirin. 2. Kök dizindeki start.bat dosyasına çift tıklayın. 3. WebUI otomatik olarak adresinde açılacaktır! 2. Manuel Kurulum bash 1. Repoyu klonlayın git clone cd AutoShorts-Studio 2. Sanal ortam oluşturup aktif edin python -m venv .venv Windows için: .venv\Scripts\activate Linux/macOS için: source .venv/bin/activate 3. Bağımlılıkları yükleyin pip install -r AutoShortsStudio/requirements.txt 4. WebUI'ı başlatın streamlit run AutoShortsStudio/webui/Main.py Alternatif: REST API servisini başlatmak için python AutoShortsStudio/main.py --- ⚙️ Yapılandırma (config.toml) İlk çalıştırmada config.example.toml dosyasından otomatik olarak bir config.toml oluşturulur. Kullanmak istediğiniz API anahtarlarını doğrudan bu dosyadan veya WebUI arayüzündeki ayarlar menüsünden belirleyebilirsiniz: toml ============================================================================= Temel Servis Ayarları ============================================================================= loglevel = "INFO" listenhost = "127.0.0.1" listenport = 8080 [app] LLM Sağlayıcısı: "openai", "gemini", "deepseek", "moonshot", "ollama", "azure" vb. llmprovider = "openai" openaiapikey = "sk-..." openaimodelname = "gpt-4o" Stok Medya Sağlayıcıları pexelsapikeys = ["YOURPEXELSKEY"] pixabayapikeys = ["YOURPIXABAYKEY"] Klip ve Shorts Otomasyonu maxvideoagedays = 7 # Yalnızca son 7 günün videoları viralthresholdforolder = 50000 # 7 günden eski ise en az 50.000 izlenme titleblacklist = "açıklama, sorun, duyuru, bilgilendirme, güncelleme" introtrimseconds = 5.0 # Giriş jenerik kesme süresi outrotrimseconds = 6.0 # Bitiş ekranı kesme süresi enablekickdiscovery = false # Kick keşfi (varsayılan YouTube/Twitch) --- 🔑 YouTube Otomatik Yayıncı Kurulumu AutoShorts Studio, üretilen veya kesilen Shorts videolarını doğrudan kanalınıza yükleyebilir: 1. Google Cloud Console üzerinden yeni bir proje oluşturun ve YouTube Data API v3 servisini etkinleştirin. 2. OAuth 2.0 İstemci Kimliği oluşturup JSON dosyasını indirin. 3. İndirdiğiniz dosyayı AutoShortsStudio/resource/clientsecret.json olarak kaydedin. 4. Kök dizindeki authyoutube.bat dosyasını çalıştırın (veya terminalden python AutoShortsStudio/authenticateyoutube.py). 5. Açılan tarayıcı penceresinde YouTube kanalınızı onaylayın. 6. Yetkilendirme token'ı otomatik olarak kaydedilecek ve sistem zamanlanmış yüklemelere hazır hale gelecektir. --- 🐳 Docker ile Dağıtım CPU Sürümü bash docker compose up -d Tarayıcınızda adresine gidin. NVIDIA GPU Hızlandırmalı Sürüm (CUDA 12.1) Whisper transkripsiyonu ve video render işlemlerini ekran kartınızda koşturmak için: bash docker build -f AutoShortsStudio/Dockerfile.gpu -t autoshorts-studio:gpu AutoShortsStudio/ docker run --gpus all \ -v $(pwd)/config.toml:/AutoShortsStudio/config.toml \ -v $(pwd)/storage:/AutoShortsStudio/storage \ -p 127.0.0.1:8501:8501 autoshorts-studio:gpu --- 📂 Proje Dosya Yapısı text AutoShorts-Studio/ ├── AutoShortsStudio/ # Ana uygulama kaynak kodu │ ├── app/ │ │ ├── config/ # Dinamik yapılandırma yöneticisi │ │ ├── controllers/v1/ # Video ve Klip REST API endpoint'leri │ │ ├── models/ # Pydantic veri şemaları & tip tanımları │ │ ├── services/ # Çekirdek servisler │ │ │ ├── clipdownloader.py # YouTube / Twitch / Kick video indirici │ │ │ ├── clipeditor.py # FFmpeg video işleme ve altyazı giydirme │ │ │ ├── clippublisher.py # YouTube Shorts otomatik yükleyici │ │ │ ├── clipscheduler.py # Otopilot arka plan zamanlayıcısı │ │ │ ├── hypedetector.py # ebur128 ses tepe noktası analizi │ │ │ ├── llm.py # Çoklu LLM senaryo üretim motoru │ │ │ ├── material.py # Stok video arama & indirme │ │ │ ├── subtitle.py # Faster-Whisper karaoke altyazı motoru │ │ │ ├── video.py # MoviePy video sentezleyicisi │ │ │ └── voice.py # Edge-TTS / Kokoro / ElevenLabs TTS motoru │ ├── webui/ # Streamlit Web arayüzü & bileşenleri │ ├── resource/ # Fontlar, ses efektleri, telifsiz müzikler │ ├── test/ # 550+ birim ve entegrasyon test paketi │ ├── cli.py # Komut satırı arayüzü │ ├── main.py # FastAPI sunucu giriş noktası │ ├── pyproject.toml # Proje paket ve bağımlılık manifestosu │ └── requirements.txt # Python bağımlılık listesi ├── lib/ # Taşınabilir yerel FFmpeg ve Python araçları ├── api.bat # REST API başlatma kısayolu ├── authyoutube.bat # YouTube OAuth yetkilendirme kısayolu ├── start.bat # WebUI başlatma kısayolu └── update.bat # Otomatik bağımlılık güncelleme kısayolu --- 📄 Lisans Bu proje MIT Lisansı altında lisanslanmıştır. content:
Repository: genpixy-ai/ai-whiteboard-video-generator
    Description: AI whiteboard animation video generator: turn a topic or script into a narrated explainer video with subtitles. CLI, MCP server, and GitHub Action for faceless YouTube and Shorts automation.
    Language: Python
    Topics: ai-agents, ai-video-generator, api, explainer-video, explainer-video-generation, explainer-videos, faceless-video, faceless-video-generator, mcp, mcp-server, script-to-video, text-to-video, text-to-video-api, text-to-video-generation, whiteboard-animation

    README:
    AI Whiteboard Video Generator Turn a topic or a script into a narrated whiteboard animation video in one command. You get an MP4 with a hand-drawn whiteboard animation, an AI voiceover, word-by-word subtitles, background music, a thumbnail, and a ready YouTube title and description. Use it as a text to video and script to video tool from your terminal, make a whole faceless YouTube channel from a topics list, run it every day with GitHub Actions, or let an AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex) make videos through the MCP server. Made with one command: whiteboard-video make "How black holes form, explained simply for curious teenagers" (62 s, 720p, unedited) Features - ✍️ Whiteboard animation from text. A hand draws every icon, label, and diagram while the narrator talks. - 🎨 3 styles. whiteboard (doodle and scribe video), animate (cartoon animation), and flat (color board). - 🗣️ AI voiceover in 76 languages. The narration follows the language of your prompt: English, Indonesian, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic, Portuguese, and more. Male or female voice. - 💬 Word-by-word subtitles burned into the video, plus an .srt file. - 📱 YouTube and Shorts formats. Landscape 16:9 for YouTube, vertical portrait for Shorts, TikTok, and Reels. 720p or 1080p. 30 seconds to 10 minutes. - 🏷️ Ready to publish. Every video comes with a thumbnail, a YouTube title, a description, and hashtags. - 🚫 No watermark on videos made through the API. - 🔁 Safe to rerun. Each topic maps to one video. If a run stops, run the same command again: it resumes and you never pay twice for the same topic. - 🤖 Agent ready. Remote MCP server and an Agent Skills file for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, and Claude Desktop. Quick start 1. Get an API key. Create one at genpixy.com → Account → API keys. Videos use your GenPixy balance. bash export GENPIXYAPIKEY=gpxyourkeyhere 2. Install with uv (or use pipx): bash uv tool install git+ 3. Make a video: bash whiteboard-video make "How black holes form, explained simply for curious teenagers" The tool shows the cost and your balance, asks once, and then shows progress until the video is done: text Making 1 video. Cost per video: … Balance: …. Start? [Y/n]: y How black holes form, explained simply for curio ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 100% done ┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━┳━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓ ┃ Video ┃ Result ┃ Length ┃ Folder / link ┃ ┡━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━╇━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┩ │ How Black Holes Form │ ✓ made │ 63 s │ videos/how-black-holes-form-explained-simply… │ └──────────────────────┴────────┴────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────┘ Each video gets its own folder: text videos/how-black-holes-form-explained-simply-for-curiou-4283b762/ ├── video.mp4 # the video (H.264 + AAC) ├── subtitles.srt # subtitles ├── thumbnail.png # thumbnail └── video.json # YouTube title, description, hashtags, settings, and the GenPixy link More examples: bash A YouTube Short in Indonesian with a female voice whiteboard-video make "Kenapa langit berwarna biru?" --portrait --seconds 30 --voice female Turn your own script into a 2-minute cartoon animation in 1080p whiteboard-video make "$(cat script.txt)" --style animate --seconds 120 --resolution 1080p Check your balance and the cost of each length whiteboard-video account whiteboard-video prices Make many videos: faceless YouTube automation Put your topics in a CSV file (only prompt is required) or a text file with one topic per line: csv id,prompt,seconds,orientation,style,voice black-holes,"How black holes form, explained simply for curious teenagers",60,landscape,whiteboard,male photosynthesis,How plants turn sunlight into food,60,portrait,whiteboard,female compound-interest,"Why compound interest makes money grow faster over time, with one simple example",90,landscape,flat,male bash whiteboard-video batch topics.csv --out videos - The tool checks the whole file first and lists every problem with its line number. - Finished topics are skipped. Run the same command tomorrow with new rows, and only the new topics are made. - --limit 3 makes at most 3 new videos per run. --json prints the results as JSON for your own scripts. - Columns: id, prompt, seconds, orientation, resolution, style, language, voice, subtitles, music, bigboard, zoomdive. Empty cells use the command-line defaults. See topics.example.csv for a full example. Upload to YouTube (beta) Install the YouTube extra and sign in once with an OAuth client from Google Cloud (YouTube Data API v3, application type "Desktop app"): bash uv tool install "ai-whiteboard-video-generator[youtube] @ git+ whiteboard-video youtube login --client-secret clientsecret.json Then upload while you make videos, or upload finished folders later: bash whiteboard-video batch topics.csv --youtube private whiteboard-video youtube upload videos --privacy unlisted whiteboard-video youtube upload videos/black-holes --publish-at 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z The upload uses the generated YouTube title, description, hashtags, and thumbnail. A folder that is already on YouTube gets a youtube.json file and is never uploaded twice. Custom thumbnails need a verified YouTube channel. Use it from AI agents: MCP server and skill GenPixy has a remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, so an agent can make videos with tools instead of HTTP calls. - URL: (Streamable HTTP) - Header: Authorization: Bearer - Tools: createvideo, getvideo, listvideos, getaccount, getoptions bash Claude Code claude mcp add --transport http genpixy \ --header "Authorization: Bearer $GENPIXYAPIKEY" Codex codex mcp add genpixy --url --bearer-token-env-var GENPIXYAPIKEY Setup for Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, and other clients: docs/mcp.md. No MCP? Use the skill. skills/genpixy/SKILL.md teaches any agent that can run commands how to make videos. Install it for Claude Code: bash mkdir -p /.claude/skills/genpixy && curl -fsSL -o /.claude/skills/genpixy/SKILL.md Or just paste this into your agent: text Read and make me a 60-second whiteboard video about how black holes form. Make a video every day with GitHub Actions Copy examples/github-actions/daily-video.yml into .github/workflows/ of your own repository, add a topics.csv, and add the secret GENPIXYAPIKEY. Every day the workflow makes the next topic, keeps the files as a workflow artifact, and remembers finished topics in git. Add the secret YOUTUBETOKENJSON to also upload each video to YouTube. All options | Option | Values | Default | | --- | --- | --- | | --seconds | 30, 60, 90, 120, 180, 300, 480, 600 | 60 | | --portrait | vertical video for Shorts, TikTok, and Reels | landscape 16:9 | | --resolution | 720p, 1080p | 720p | | --style | whiteboard, animate (cartoon), flat (color board) | whiteboard | | --language | auto (follows the prompt), en, id | auto | | --voice | male, female | male | | --no-subtitles | turn off subtitles | on | | --no-music | turn off background music | on | | --big-board | all scenes on one board, with a zoom-out recap | off | | --zoom-dive | the camera flies into an icon between scenes | off | | --out, -o | folder for the videos | videos | | --fresh | make a new version of a topic that was made before | off | | --youtube | also upload: private, unlisted, public | no upload | | --yes, -y | do not ask before starting | ask | | --json | print results as JSON on stdout | off | Use it as a Python library python from pathlib import Path from whiteboardvideo.client import GenPixyClient from whiteboardvideo.models import Orientation, VideoRequest from whiteboardvideo.videos import makevideo with GenPixyClient("gpx...") as client: request = VideoRequest(prompt="How volcanoes erupt", seconds=30, orientation=Orientation.PORTRAIT) saved = makevideo(client, request, Path("videos/volcanoes")) print(saved.result.youtubetitle, saved.appurl) The client retries network errors and busy answers with the same Idempotency-Key, so a retry never starts a second video. Prefer plain HTTP? See the API docs and the OpenAPI file. FAQ What is a whiteboard animation video? An explainer video where a hand draws simple pictures on a white board while a narrator explains the topic. It is also called a doodle video, scribe video, or sketch video. It works well for lessons, explainers, and faceless YouTube channels. How is this different from VideoScribe or Doodly? In those editors you place every drawing on a timeline by hand. Here you write a topic or paste a script, and you get the whole video: drawings, voiceover, subtitles, and music. You can also make many videos from a file, or from an AI agent. Is it free? This tool is free and open source (MIT). Each video uses your GenPixy balance. Run whiteboard-video prices to see the cost of each length for your account. Failed or canceled videos cost nothing. To try GenPixy without the API, use the free plan on genpixy.com. Do the videos have a watermark? No. Videos made through the API never have a watermark. Which languages are supported? The narration follows the language of your prompt, in 76 languages. Write the prompt in Indonesian, and you get an Indonesian voiceover and Indonesian subtitles. How long does a video take? Most short videos are ready in a few minutes. Your account can make 2 videos at the same time. The batch command waits for a free slot by itself. Can I use my own script? Yes. Pass up to 5,000 characters of notes or a full script as the prompt. Line breaks and Markdown lists are fine. About GenPixy GenPixy AI generates explainer whiteboard or cartoon animation videos. Perfect for faceless content creation or education. - 🌐 Website: genpixy.com - 🎬 Example videos with their prompts: DrawGen Watch - 📘 API docs: genpixy.com/api/docs Development bash uv sync --all-extras uv run pytest -q uv run ruff check && uv run basedpyright Issues and pull requests are welcome. License MIT

    README:
    🎬 ClipPulse AI Turn any long video into viral 9:16 clips for TikTok, Reels & Shorts — with AI. Paste a YouTube link or drop in your own video. ClipPulse uses Google Gemini to find the most engaging moments, generates bold animated captions, applies auto zoom, and drops everything into a built-in clip editor for fine-tuning. Everything runs locally — your videos never leave your machine. > Building in public. Follow the journey on Threads @yusifkishidir. > 📘 New here? Full step-by-step tutorial (install, Gemini key, your first clip in 5 min): --- ✨ Why ClipPulse? - 🧠 AI Moment Finder — Gemini scores every moment for virality and pulls the highlights (podcasts, gaming, sports, vlogs). - 💬 Animated Captions + Zoom — word-synced subtitles with glow, gradient and auto zoom that locks onto the action. - ✂️ 9:16 Clip Editor — cut, split and delete on a timeline; retype captions; restyle colors; then re-render in one click. - 🌍 14 languages — full UI in English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Português, Русский, العربية, 日本語, 한국어, 中文, हिन्दी, Nederlands. - 🚀 Fast — GPU-accelerated rendering with automatic CPU fallback. - 🔒 Private by design — runs entirely in your browser + local server. Your Gemini key stays with you, files are processed locally, and there's no monthly lock-in. 🖥️ How it works 1. Paste a YouTube URL or upload an MP4/MOV/AVI. 2. ClipPulse downloads (or uses your file), transcribes the audio with Whisper, and asks Gemini to rank the viral moments. 3. Each moment is cut into a 9:16 clip with animated captions and zoom. 4. Open the editor to tweak text, colors, zoom focus and timing, then re-render. 5. Download your clips — done. 🚀 Quick start Requirements - Python 3.10+ - ffmpeg on your PATH - A Google Gemini API key (free tier works) - (optional) NVIDIA GPU for faster rendering Install & run bash git clone cd ClipPulse-AI python3 -m venv backend/venv source backend/venv/bin/activate pip install -r backend/requirements.txt add your Gemini key (stored locally in backend/config/settings.json) python3 backend/server.py # then open → Settings → paste key or set it directly python3 - <<'PY' import json, pathlib p = pathlib.Path("backend/config/settings.json") p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, existok=True) cfg = json.loads(p.readtext()) if p.exists() else {} cfg["geminiapikey"] = "YOURKEYHERE" p.writetext(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2)) PY python3 backend/server.py Open and start creating. ⚙️ Configuration Settings (stored in backend/config/settings.json, git-ignored): | Key | Description | Default | |-----|-------------|---------| | geminiapikey | Google Gemini API key | — | | clipcount | Clips generated per video | 6 | | whispermodel | tiny / base / small | base | | language | Transcription language ("" = auto) | "" | 🧩 Tech stack - Backend: Flask, yt-dlp, OpenAI Whisper, Google Gemini, FFmpeg (libx264) - Frontend: Vanilla JS, 14-language i18n, self-hosted Poppins, glassy dark UI 🗺️ Roadmap - [ ] Brand kits (font / color / logo / caption style) - [ ] Auto import + scheduling from YouTube/Twitch/Kick - [ ] Multi-speaker labels & layout - [ ] Landscape export presets - [ ] One-click share to TikTok / Reels / Shorts 🤝 Contributing PRs welcome! Run the translation parity check before opening a PR: bash python3 scripts/checktranslations.py 📄 License MIT — do what you want, just keep the credits.

Tự động xây dựng kịch bản SEO Viral: Tiêu đề giật tít song ngữ (Việt/Anh), Câu hook 3 giây đầu giữ chân khán giả, Thiết kế âm thanh (Sound Design ASMR), Bộ Hashtags và Thẻ từ khóa thịnh hành. - Tự động quét thư mục video & Tải lên YouTube (Auto-Uploader): Kiểm tra chuẩn Shorts (9:16, $\le$ 60s), ghép cặp kịch bản SEO, tự động đặt lịch đăng (Scheduled Upload) theo khung giờ vàng và quản lý hạn mức API (Google Quota Staging). --- ✨ Tính Năng Nổi Bật 1. 🎨 Studio Tạo Prompt Đơn Lẻ (Single Studio) - 6 Danh Mục Chủ Đề Phong Phú: - 🥑 Trái Cây Đá Quý (Gemstone Fruits): Bơ ngọc lục bảo, Dâu tây ruby, Dưa hấu sapphire, Thanh long thạch anh tím... - 📱 Công Nghệ & Thạch (Cyber Jelly & Tech): iPhone thạch dạ quang, Game Boy pha lê vi mạch neon... - 🪐 Hành Tinh & Vũ Trụ (Cosmic Spheres): Cắt đôi Trái Đất lõi dung nham, Sao Thổ xoáy dải ngân hà... - 🍰 Ảo Ảnh Bánh & Sáp (Illusion Cakes & Wax): Cắt thỏi vàng/gạch đá mềm như bơ lộ cốt bánh kem phát sáng... - 🐉 Trứng Rồng & Geode (Dragon Eggs & Geode): Vỏ vảy rồng bạc, tổ ong hổ phách tràn tinh chất phát quang... - 🌊 Đại Dương Pha Lê (Crystal Marine Shells): Ốc Nautilus xà cừ, sao biển thủy tinh chứa bọt sóng phát sáng... - Tùy biến sâu sắc: Chọn loại đá quý, chất lỏng phát sáng bên trong (mật ong nano, vàng lỏng, dung nham rực lửa...), dụng cụ cắt (Dao Damascus nhiệt, Tia Laser Plasma, Kiếm Katana Nano...), phong cách thẩm mỹ và nền tảng AI mục tiêu. - Xuất bản Prompt 1-Click: Tách riêng Prompt ảnh mở đầu (Start Frame), ảnh kết thúc (End Frame) và Prompt Video Morphing/Motion chuyển động cắt. 2. ⚡ Xử Lý Hàng Loạt Tự Động (Batch Queue Manager) - Tạo nhanh 10, 20, 50 kịch bản cùng lúc hoàn toàn ngẫu nhiên hoặc theo ma trận định sẵn. - Bộ điều phối tiến trình thông minh (Rate-Limiter & Auto-Retry) ngăn chặn việc chạm ngưỡng giới hạn (429 Too Many Requests) của Gemini API. - Xuất dữ liệu kịch bản ra định dạng JSON, CSV hoặc TXT để tích hợp với các công cụ tự động hóa khác. 3. 📤 Tự Động Quét & Tải Video Lên YouTube (Auto-Uploader) - Folder Scanner: Quét trực tiếp thư mục render video (.mp4, .mov, .webm) từ máy tính cá nhân. - Smart Media Inspector: Tự động kiểm tra tỷ lệ khung hình (chuẩn 9:16 dọc), thời lượng video ($\le$ 60 giây), độ phân giải và cảnh báo nếu video không đạt chuẩn YouTube Shorts. - Smart Idea Matcher: Tự động ghép nối video trong thư mục với kịch bản SEO tương ứng theo tên file hoặc nội dung. - Lên lịch đăng thông minh (Scheduled Upload): Thiết lập lịch xuất bản tự động theo khung giờ vàng (ví dụ: 11:30 & 18:30 hàng ngày). - Auto Multi-Day Quota Staging: Tự động phân bổ số lượng video đăng sang các ngày tiếp theo dựa trên hạn mức 10,000 units/ngày của YouTube Data API v3 (mỗi lần upload tốn 1,600 units). 4. 📊 Bảng Điều Khiển Hạn Mức & Thống Kê (Analytics & Quota Dashboard) - Giám sát mức tiêu thụ Quota YouTube Data API v3 theo thời gian thực (Tránh bị khóa API do vượt 10,000 units/ngày). - Hiển thị thông tin kênh YouTube kết nối (Avatar, Tên kênh, Số lượng người đăng ký - Subscribers). - Biểu đồ thống kê lịch sử đăng video và lịch trình dự kiến trong tương lai. 5. 📚 Quản Lý Lịch Sử & Cẩm Nang Sáng Tạo (History & Workflow Guide) - Lưu trữ toàn bộ kịch bản đã tạo vào localStorage an toàn trên máy tính cá nhân. - Bộ lọc tìm kiếm nhanh, đánh dấu kịch bản yêu thích (Favorites). - Tích hợp cẩm nang 5 bước quy trình sản xuất video Shorts triệu view và lối tắt nhanh đến các nền tảng AI (Google AI Studio, Midjourney, Kling AI, Runway, Suno AI, CapCut...). --- 🛠️ Công Nghệ Sử Dụng (Tech Stack) | Thành phần | Công nghệ | | :--- | :--- | | Desktop Runtime | Electron 34 | | Frontend Framework | React 18 + TypeScript 5 | | Build Tool & Bundler | Vite 6 | | Styling | Tailwind CSS 3 + PostCSS + Autoprefixer | | Icons & Visuals | Lucide React + Canvas Confetti | | AI Integration | Google Gemini 2.5 API (gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro) | | Video & Data APIs | YouTube Data API v3 (OAuth 2.0 Direct Integration) | | Packaging & Installer | Electron Builder 25 (Windows NSIS / Portable Installer) | --- 📋 Yêu Cầu Hệ Thống - Hệ điều hành: Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 12+, hoặc Linux. - Node.js: Phiên bản >= 18.0.0 (Khuyên dùng Node.js LTS 20.x hoặc 22.x). - Package Manager: npm (đi kèm Node.js) hoặc yarn / pnpm. - API Keys cần thiết: - Google Gemini API Key: Lấy miễn phí tại Google AI Studio. - Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials (Tùy chọn, chỉ cần nếu dùng tính năng tự động đăng video YouTube): Tạo Client ID dạng Desktop App tại Google Cloud Console. --- 🚀 Cài Đặt & Chạy Ứng Dụng 1. Cài đặt các gói phụ thuộc Mở Terminal tại thư mục dự án và chạy: bash npm install 2. Chạy ứng dụng ở môi trường phát triển (Development Mode) - Khởi chạy ứng dụng Desktop Electron (Khuyên dùng): bash npm run electron:dev (Lệnh này sẽ tự động khởi động máy chủ Vite và mở cửa sổ ứng dụng Electron). - Chạy giao diện Web trên trình duyệt: bash npm run dev Truy cập vào địa chỉ: --- 📦 Hướng Dẫn Đóng Gói Ứng Dụng Desktop (.exe) Để đóng gói thành bộ cài đặt hoàn chỉnh cho Windows: bash npm run electron:build - Hệ thống sẽ tự động dọn dẹp các tiến trình Electron cũ đang chạy (thông qua scripts/kill-running.js), biên dịch TypeScript cho cả Renderer và Main process, sau đó tạo file cài đặt Windows .exe trong thư mục: dist-electron-build/ --- 📖 Hướng Dẫn Sử Dụng Chi Tiết mermaid flowchart LR A["1. Chọn Ma Trận Chủ Đề\n(Đá Quý, Chất Lỏng, Dao)"] --> B["2. Sinh Prompt & Kịch Bản\n(Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro)"] B --> C["3. Tạo Ảnh & Video AI\n(Midjourney / Kling / Veo)"] C --> D["4. Hậu Kỳ Âm Thanh ASMR\n(CapCut / Premiere)"] D --> E["5. Quét Thư Mục & Đăng YouTube\n(Auto-Uploader & Schedule)"] Bước 1: Thiết lập Gemini API Key 1. Nhấp vào biểu tượng Cài đặt API (hoặc nút nhập API Key trên thanh điều hướng). 2. Dán mã Gemini API Key từ Google AI Studio. 3. Bấm Kiểm tra kết nối để đảm bảo key hoạt động chính xác. Bước 2: Tạo Prompt & Kịch bản (Single hoặc Batch) 1. Chế độ đơn lẻ: Chọn danh mục $\rightarrow$ Chọn vật thể $\rightarrow$ Chọn loại đá quý $\rightarrow$ Chọn chất lỏng tuôn trào $\rightarrow$ Chọn dụng cụ cắt $\rightarrow$ Bấm Tạo Kịch Bản & Prompt AI. 2. Chế độ hàng loạt: Vào tab Hàng Loạt (Batch Queue) $\rightarrow$ Chọn số lượng cần tạo (ví dụ 10 kịch bản) $\rightarrow$ Bấm Tạo ngẫu nhiên & Chạy. 3. Sao chép các Prompt tương ứng: - Start Image Prompt: Dán vào Midjourney hoặc ChatGPT (DALL-E 3) để tạo ảnh vật thể nguyên vẹn. - End Image Prompt: Tạo ảnh mặt cắt lộ cấu trúc đá quý và chất lỏng tuôn trào. - Video Morphing Prompt: Nạp vào Google Veo 2, Kling AI hoặc Runway Gen-3 (Image-to-Video) để diễn hoạt cảnh cắt mượt mà. Bước 3: Đăng Video YouTube Shorts Tự Động 1. Đặt tất cả video đã render vào một thư mục trên máy tính. 2. Mở tab Đăng YouTube (YouTube Uploader) $\rightarrow$ Nhấp Chọn thư mục video. 3. Kết nối tài khoản YouTube bằng Google OAuth 2.0. 4. Kiểm tra danh sách video đã được ghép cặp tiêu đề, mô tả và hashtags chuẩn SEO. 5. Cấu hình lịch phát sóng (ví dụ: 2 video/ngày vào 11:30 và 18:30) $\rightarrow$ Bấm Bắt đầu Tải lên & Đặt lịch. --- 📁 Cấu Trúc Thư Mục Dự Án Youtube-Tool/ ├── electron/ # Mã nguồn Electron Main & Preload Process │ ├── main.ts # Xử lý cửa sổ, Native Dialogs, IPC Handlers │ └── preload.ts # Cầu nối an toàn ContextBridge giữa Electron và React ├── scripts/ │ └── kill-running.js # Script đóng tiến trình Electron cũ khi build ├── src/ # Mã nguồn ứng dụng React │ ├── components/ # Các Component giao diện chính │ │ ├── Header.tsx # Thanh điều hướng và cài đặt API Key │ │ ├── MatrixSelector.tsx # Ma trận lựa chọn chủ đề & đá quý │ │ ├── PromptOutputCard.tsx # Hiển thị kịch bản, prompt ảnh & video, SEO │ │ ├── BatchQueueManager.tsx # Quản lý hàng đợi tạo hàng loạt │ │ ├── HistoryView.tsx # Lịch sử và bộ sưu tập yêu thích │ │ ├── YouTubeUploaderView.tsx # Quét thư mục & tải video lên YouTube │ │ ├── AnalyticsDashboardView.tsx# Biểu đồ hạn mức API & kênh YouTube │ │ ├── DirectLinksModal.tsx # Lối tắt nhanh tới các công cụ AI │ │ └── TipsGuideModal.tsx # Hướng dẫn quy trình sản xuất video │ ├── data/ │ │ └── gemstoneMatrix.ts # Cơ sở dữ liệu ma trận vật thể, đá quý, hiệu ứng │ ├── services/ # Tầng dịch vụ logic & API │ │ ├── geminiService.ts # Kết nối và sinh prompt với Gemini API │ │ ├── youtubeService.ts # Tích hợp YouTube Data API v3 & OAuth 2.0 │ │ ├── quotaService.ts # Quản lý & tính toán hạn mức Quota │ │ ├── mediaService.ts # Kiểm tra định dạng, độ dài, chuẩn Shorts │ │ ├── queueService.ts # Quản lý hàng đợi tác vụ hàng loạt │ │ └── exportService.ts # Xuất dữ liệu JSON / CSV / TXT │ ├── types/ # Khai báo TypeScript Interfaces & Types │ ├── App.tsx # Component trung tâm điều phối Tab │ ├── main.tsx # Điểm khởi chạy React DOM │ └── index.css # Cấu hình Tailwind CSS ├── electron-builder.json5 # Cấu hình đóng gói ứng dụng Desktop Windows ├── package.json # Danh sách dependencies và npm scripts ├── tsconfig.json # Cấu hình TypeScript cho React ├── tsconfig.electron.json # Cấu hình TypeScript cho Electron ├── vite.config.ts # Cấu hình máy chủ phát triển Vite └── .gitignore # Cấu hình loại trừ file nhạy cảm và thư mục build --- 🔒 Bảo Mật & An Toàn Dữ Liệu (Security & Privacy) - Lưu trữ cục bộ (Local Storage): Mọi thông tin nhạy cảm bao gồm Gemini API Key, Google OAuth Tokens, và Lịch sử kịch bản đều được lưu trữ trực tiếp trên thiết bị của bạn (localStorage / Electron local environment), tuyệt đối không gửi về bất kỳ máy chủ trung gian nào. - Git Protection: Tệp .gitignore đã được cấu hình chặt chẽ để loại trừ toàn bộ file .env, credentials.json, token.json, clientsecret.json nhằm đảm bảo không bao giờ vô tình đẩy khóa bảo mật lên kho mã nguồn công khai. --- 📄 Bản Quyền & Tác Giả - Tác giả: Triet (trietngo-dev) - Dự án: Gemstone Fruit AI Studio © 2026. - Được thiết kế và tối ưu cho cộng đồng nhà sáng tạo nội dung YouTube Shorts quốc tế.

description: A powerful tool to automatically generate AI-driven YouTube shorts, Instagram Reels and TikToks. Create engaging content in seconds with our AI-powered video generator!
content:
Repository: AppSolves/QuickClipAI
    Description: A powerful tool to automatically generate AI-driven YouTube shorts, Instagram Reels and TikToks. Create engaging content in seconds with our AI-powered video generator!
    Language: Python
    Topics: ai, automation, instagram, tiktok, tools, video-creation, youtube

    README:
    ----- Check out these examples of videos generated using QuickClipAI (by CurioBurstz): ----- QuickClipAI QuickClipAI is a tool that uses AI to automatically create engaging YouTube shorts and videos from text inputs. Sit back and relax while QuickClipAI boosts your productivity! Introduction • Features • Installation • Usage • Credits • License > 👋 This is a very early release and lots more documentation and functionality is currently being added. QuickClipAI 🤖 Introduction 📖 Welcome to the QuickClipAI Project! This project aims to provide an efficient and powerful AI-driven tool for generating engaging YouTube shorts and videos automatically. Whether you're a content creator, marketer, or just someone looking to boost your online presence, QuickClipAI offers a seamless and creative video generation solution. Features 🚀 - AI-Driven Content Generation: Leverages advanced AI algorithms to automatically create engaging YouTube shorts and videos from text inputs. - Customizable Video Settings: Allows users to adjust various parameters such as length, style, and theme to suit their content needs. - High-Quality Output: Ensures videos are generated with professional quality, ready for upload to YouTube or other platforms. Installation 🛠️ Binaries & Packages 📦 1. Clone the Repository: Clone the repository to your local machine using: bash git clone 2. Install Dependencies: Navigate to the root directory and install the required libraries using: bash python -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt 3. Install Fooocus: Download the latest release of Fooocus for your operating system and specify it's path within main.py before any other function calls: > ⚠️ IMPORTANT: This project was developed and tested using Fooocus version 2.5.5. If you encounter any issues with other versions, please install the specified version. python Running this will save the path to the config/config.json file. Once the path is saved, you can and should run the script without those lines. settingsmanager = SettingsManager() settingsmanager.set( "fooocuspath", { "interpreter": r"path\to\fooocus\embeded\python\interpreter", # Can be 'python3' on Unix systems, while Windows systems require the full path to the embedded interpreter. "script": r"path\to\fooocus\launch.py", }, encrypt=False, # You can set this to True if you want to encrypt sensitive data. ) 4. Install ffmpeg: Download and install ffmpeg from the official website. Make sure to add the binary to your system's PATH variable. 5. Install ImageMagick: Download and install ImageMagick from the official website as well. Make sure to tick both boxes that - add the binary to your system's PATH variable. - install the legacy utilities (e.g. convert.exe). 6. Install Chrome: Chrome and ChromeDriver are necessary if you would like to use background music from Bensound (refer to the BensoundBackgroundMusic class) or make automatic uploads to Instagram and TikTok. Make sure to download the latest version of Chrome and the ChromeDriver respectively. Make sure to add the ChromeDriver binary to your system's PATH variable. Providers and API setup 🌐 1. You need to obtain an API key from ElevenLabs (they have a free plan) to be able to generate automatic voiceovers. You can set this key in the same .env file as above by adding the ELEVENLABSAPIKEY key or by setting it using the SettingsManager class: python Again, you may remove these lines after executing the script once. settingsmanager = SettingsManager() settingsmanager.set( "elevenlabsapikey", " ", encrypt=True, # Encryption is recommended for sensitive data. ) You can also set the API key using the command line interface (CLI) as follows (better for shorter data): bash python main.py settings set "elevenlabsapikey" " " -e 2. In order to generate text, the G4FAPI uses g4f.Provider.OpenaiChat as the default provider. You can change this by passing a custom provider to the G4FAPI class. The setup of .har files is necessary for authentication. You can set these files in the config/harandcookies directory and the G4FAPI class will automatically use them: > ⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to function correctly, some providers, e.g. "you.com", require cookies to be set. You can set these cookies by generating a .har file for the provider's website using your browser's developer tools and placing it in the config/harandcookies directory. If ENCRYPTIONKEY is set, the .har file will be encrypted when the program is run for the first time and only decrypted during runtime. Source: Official gpt4free repository. Example for chatgpt.com and g4f.Provider.OpenaiChat respectively: > To utilize the OpenaiChat provider, a .har file is required from Follow the steps below to create a valid .har file: > 1. Navigate to using your preferred web browser and log in with your credentials. > 2. Access the Developer Tools in your browser. This can typically be done by right-clicking the page and selecting "Inspect," or by pressing F12 or Ctrl+Shift+I (Cmd+Option+I on a Mac). > 3. With the Developer Tools open, switch to the "Network" tab. > 4. Reload the website to capture the loading process within the Network tab. > 5. Initiate an action in the chat which can be captured in the .har file. > 6. Right-click any of the network activities listed and select "Save all as HAR with content" to export the .har file. In order to make use of the automatic upload features, you need to add your YouTube credentials to the config/config.json file using the SettingsManager class. The UploadAPI class will automatically use these credentials to upload the generated video to the respective platform: python You SHOULD remove these lines after executing the script once. settingsmanager = SettingsManager() settingsmanager.set( "publisher", { "youtube": { "installed": { "clientid": " .apps.googleusercontent.com", "projectid": " ", "authuri": " "tokenuri": " "authproviderx509certurl": " "clientsecret": " ", "redirecturis": [" } }, }, encrypt=True, # You should definitely encrypt sensitive data. ) > ⚠️ IMPORTANT: For Instagram and TikTok, you only have to be logged in to the respective platform in your chrome browser. > > It may be necessary to occasionally resolve captchas on TikTok when using the TikTok provider until a more permanent solution is found (e.g. automatic captcha solving). Follow these guides to setup the publisher credentials: - Set up a Google Cloud Project for YouTube Customization 🎨 QuickClipAI offers a range of customization options to tailor the generated videos to your specific needs. By now, you can adjust all prompts in the prompts folder to tweak the generated content, add custom background music in the assets/project/music folder and add custom fonts in the assets/project/fonts folder. More customization options will be added in future releases. > ⚠️ IMPORTANT: By now, only .ttf fonts are supported. Make sure to add your custom fonts in the assets/project/fonts folder and run the following command in admin mode to register them: > >bash >captametropolis registerfont "assets\project\fonts\yourfont.ttf" -qr # If not run in admin mode, the command will ask for admin permissions. > > > This will register the font in the system and make it available for use in the video generation process. Make sure to not change the font name or location after registering it. > :informationsource: NOTE: You can easily add your own background music by placing the file in the assets/project/music folder and using the backgroundmusic parameter in the MoviepyAPI().generatevideo() function: > > python > moviepyapi = MoviepyAPI() > moviepyapi.generatevideo( > ..., > backgroundmusic=BackgroundMusic( > r"assets\project\music\yourmusic.mp3", > startsec=0, > volumefactor=0.2, > credits="Credits to song artist", # Optional > ), > ) > > > You can even use sound driectly from Bensound using the BensoundBackgroundMusic class, it will automatically generate the credits for you: > > python > moviepyapi.generatevideo( > ..., > backgroundmusic=BensoundBackgroundMusic( > "the lounge", # Search query for the song > startsec=0, > volumefactor=0.2, > ), > ) > Encryption 🔐 If you would like to use encryption features for the storage of configuration files, you can enable them by creating a .env file in the config directory and adding the ENCRYPTIONKEY key along with your password. The SettingsManager class currently supports encryption for str, bytes, dict, and list types. You can set the key in the .env file as follows: env ENCRYPTIONKEY=yourencryptionkey Upload to YouTube and Instagram 📤 You can easily upload your generated videos to YouTube and Instagram automatically using the UploadAPI class. You can set the youtube parameter to True to upload the video to YouTube, and the instagram and tiktok parameters to True to upload the video to Instagram and TikTok respectively. You can then use the UploadAPI class to upload the video: python uploadapi = UploadAPI() uploadapi.uploadvideo( sessionid="...", # The session ID of the video to upload (will be displayed in the console after generating the video). Leave None to use the last session ID. youtube=True, instagram=True, tiktok=True, ) Usage 📝 1. Activate Virtual Environment: Navigate to the root directory and activate the virtual environment using: bash source venv/bin/activate 2. Configure VPN: If you are using a VPN, make sure to switch the location/server regularly to avoid being blocked by the g4f.Provider. If you encounter any issues with the provider, you can set the provider parameter in the G4FAPI class to None, which will force the API to choose the best provider available automatically: python g4fapi = G4FAPI(provider=None) 3. Run the Script: Run the main script using: bash python main.py Credits 🙏 This project was developed and is maintained by AppSolves. Links - E-Mail - Website - GitHub - This Repository Also, check out CurioBurstz on YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok for more content created using QuickClipAI. License 📜 This project is licensed under a custom license with All Rights Reserved. No use, distribution, or modification is allowed without explicit permission from the author. For more information, please see the LICENSE file. QuickClipAI © 2024 by Kaan Gönüldinc Conclusion 🎉 Thank you for checking out QuickClipAI! We hope you find this tool useful for your content creation needs. If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, please feel free to reach out to us.

    Description: Automation toolkit for solo creators — turn scripts into narrated, edited faceless YouTube videos with a local pipeline.
    Language: Python
    Topics: 

    README:
    --- AI faceless YouTube channel generator — ship faceless channels on autopilot (2026) The desktop pipeline that turns one prompt into a finished upload-ready faceless video: script, voice, b-roll, subtitles, thumbnail, upload metadata. Extracted folder, one .exe, no install ceremony. --- 🧠 Overview | Category | Details | |---|---| | Product | AI faceless YouTube channel generator | | Format | Portable Windows .exe (extract → run) | | Version | v2.4 (2026 build) | | Primary use | Batch-produce faceless long-form + Shorts for revenue channels | | Engine | Local Whisper STT, multi-LLM router, diffusion image block, TTS voice bank | | Output | 1080p/4K MP4, SRT, thumbnail PNG, description + tags bundle | | Runtime | No Python, no Node, no package manager — bundled runtime | The AI faceless YouTube channel generator is a self-contained desktop studio built for the exact channel type that lives and dies on volume: no face, no camera, no editing timeline, no rented voice actors. You bring a niche and a prompt. It returns a scripted, voiced, captioned, thumbnailed, metadata-tagged video file you can drop straight into the uploader. Everything downstream of "what's the topic" is modeled, generated, and rendered on your machine. --- 📚 What is the AI faceless YouTube channel generator? | Term | Explanation | |---|---| | Faceless channel | A YouTube channel where the creator never appears; content is narration + stock/stock-style visuals + text visuals | | Prompt-to-video | One natural-language brief expands into a full produced episode without manual editing passes | | LLM router | The generator sends each scripting task to whichever model best fits (outline, hook, SEO, retention pass) | | Voice clone cart | A bank of licensed TTS voices plus optional consent-based clone from a reference clip you supply | | B-roll synthesizer | Stock library index + AI diffusion for scenes with no available footage | | Retention pass | A post-write rewrite that trims dead air, tightens hooks, and forces a mid-video re-hook | | Metadata bundle | Description, chapters, tags, pinned comment, and caption file packaged alongside the video | - Batch-produce 20+ videos a day without a human editor in the loop. - Keep one brand voice across hundreds of episodes with a fixed voice + style preset. - Grow into a new language market by re-running the same script on a different voice track. - Never pay a stock library subscription again — the synthesizer covers gaps locally. - Ship Shorts, long-form, and chaptered documentary formats from the same project. --- ✂️ Key Features | Feature | Description | Benefit | |---|---|---| | One-prompt pipeline | A single text brief drives script → voice → visuals → captions → thumbnail → metadata | Topic in, finished episode out | | Retention rewriter | Hooks the first 7 seconds, adds mid-roll re-hooks, cuts fluff | Fights the algorithm's drop-off curve | | Multi-voice narrator bank | 40+ bundled voices across 12 languages, plus consent-based clone | Match niche tone without hiring | | B-roll synthesizer | Indexes your library, falls back to paid-model diffusion for gaps | No missing footage dead ends | | Auto-caption engine | Local Whisper with word-level sync and burn-in option | Silent-scroll retention up | | Thumbnail forger | Text-on-image composition with A/B variacs | Clicks improve without Photoshop | | Metadata bundle | Auto description, chapters, tags, pinned comment | Upload-ready in one move | | Series mode | Continues a running channel's arc + consistent intro/outro | Builds binge-worthy catalogs | | Shorts cutter | Slices a long-form episode into 5 vertical Shorts | Free distribution channel | | Local render farm | Multi-core FFmpeg batch with GPU encode | Massive throughput on desktop | --- 🗂️ Feature Categories 🖊️ Script Engine - Prompt Expander — turns 5 words into a full outline with segment word budgets. - Hook Forge — generates and ranks 10 opening lines, picks the strongest. - SEO Draft — drafts titles + descriptions around a target keyword cluster. - Fact Guard — flags unverifiable claims for manual review before render. - Tone Dial — sliders for authoritative / casual / hype / documentary. - Series Memory — keeps canon consistent across a multi-episode run. 🎙️ Voice & Audio - Narrator Bank — 40+ licensed TTS voices, warmth/clarity tuning. - Consent Clone — build a voice from a clip you own the rights to. - Pronunciation Lexicon — force-correct names, brand terms, acronyms. - Music Bed Selector — royalty-free loop matching, auto-ducked under narration. - SFX Sweetener — punch-ins for emphasis without manual editing. - Loudness Normalizer — targets -14 LUFS for consistent playback. - Multi-Track Export — separate voice / music / SFX stems for pros. 🎬 Visual Compositor - Library Indexer — catalogs your local footage folder. - Diffusion Block — generates missing scenes in the niche's art style. - Ken Burns Motion — animated stills with parallax for text-heavy segments. - Kinetic Captions — word-highlight subtitle animations, brand-colorized. - Chapter Cards — auto transition cards between sections. - Brand Kit — logos, colors, lower-thirds, end-card template. - Watermark Placer — optional corner logo with position + opacity. 📈 Growth & Metadata - Thumbnail Forger — text composition + A/B variants with CTR estimates. - Title Lab — ranks titles against competitor phrasing patterns. - Tag Drafter — 8-12 relevant tags, no keyword stuffing. - Chapter Gen — timestamps auto-aligned to script structure. - Pinned Comment Writer — a CTA comment drafted for you. - Series Playlist Map — assigns episodes into a logical watch order. - Repurpose Bot — fan-out to Shorts, threads, and community posts. ⚙️ Pipeline & Ops - Batch Queue — stagger N videos over a render window. - GPU Scheduler — spillover to CPU when the GPU is busy. - Project Save/Load — resumable episodes; crash recovery. - Preset System — save a channel's entire configuration as one file. - Proxy Preview — fast low-res draft renders before final. - Auto-Updater — pulls the latest engine without re-downloading. - Telemetry Toggle — off by default; opt-in anonymous metrics. 📊 Analytics - Render Report — per-video time, cost, and quality score. - Channel Dashboard — local video library, sorted by publish readiness. - Voice Consistency Check — flags drift between narrator takes. - CTR Tracker — log real performance next to predicted. - Export CSV — hand off your catalog to a spreadsheet. --- 🧩 Module Status | Module | Status | Description | |---|---|---| | Prompt Expander | ✅ Working | Outlines full segment structure from a short brief | | Retention Rewriter | ✅ Working | Rewrites hooks and trims dead air pre-render | | Narrator Bank | ✅ Working | 40+ licensed TTS voices across 12 languages | | Consent Clone | ✅ Working | Build a voice profile from a clip you own | | Diffusion Block | ✅ Working | Local + paid-model gap-filling for b-roll | | Auto-Caption Engine | ✅ Working | Word-level synced captions via local Whisper | | Thumbnail Forger | ✅ Working | Text composition + A/B variants | | Series Mode | ✅ Working | Multi-episode canon continuity | | Shorts Cutter | ✅ Working | Long-form → 5 vertical Shorts | | Batch Queue | ✅ Working | Staggered N-video render windows | | Telemetry Toggle | ✅ Working | Off by default | --- 🛠️ Installation 1. Download the archive from the project page using the button below, or the one near the end of this page. Save the .zip to a folder with at least 8 GB free. 2. Extract the archive with 7-Zip or the Windows built-in extractor. Extract to a normal user folder — avoid Program Files and any path with a space, since the FFmpeg call chain is fussier there. 3. Run the .exe inside the extracted folder. First launch builds the local model cache (Whisper + diffusion weights) and asks where your footage library lives. Approve the Windows Firewall prompt only if you plan to let the updater check for new engine builds. > First launch downloads the model pack (4.2 GB) — this is a one-time cost. --- 🖥️ System Requirements | Component | Minimum | Recommended | |---|---|---| | OS | Windows 10 64-bit (21H2) | Windows 11 64-bit | | CPU | 4 cores / 8 threads | 8+ cores, recent gen | | RAM | 16 GB | 32 GB | | GPU | 6 GB VRAM (CUDA 11.8+) | 12 GB+ VRAM | | Storage | 25 GB free | 60 GB free (NVMe) | | Runtime | Internet for first model pull | Baseline internet, optional offline mode | --- 🎚️ Tips for best results - Keep individual prompts under 200 words — the Expander reasons better from a tight brief. - Give each channel its own saved Preset so brand voice never bleeds between projects. - Run at least 3 Hook Forge passes; the highest-ranked hook is rarely the winner on your audience. - Feed the Library Indexer real footage you own; synthesized b-roll reads as generic when overused. - Do a proxy preview at 480p before spending GPU time on a final 4K pass. - Treat the Fact Guard flags as required reading — a single wrong stat can sink a channel. - In Series Mode, keep a running notes file so narration stays in canon across episodes. --- 🐛 Known Issues | Issue | Solution | |---|---| | First render stalls at "loading models" | Confirm the model pack finished downloading; close and reopen after the pull completes | | Voice clone sounds muffled | Supply a cleaner 30s+ reference clip with minimal room tone | | GPU encode fails on 6 GB cards in 4K | Switch the encoder to the CPU path or drop to 1080p | | Captions desync on rapid speaker changes | Run the Auto-Caption re-sync pass in the timeline panel | | Updater can't reach the server | Check firewall allowance for the .exe; the app must reach the update endpoint | --- 🤝 Compatibility / Platform Support | Platform | Support | Notes | |---|---|---| | Windows 11 (64-bit) | Full | Primary target — all modules enabled | | Windows 10 (64-bit) | Full | Requires 21H2 or newer | | Windows on ARM | Partial | No GPU encode; CPU-only render path | | macOS / Linux | Planned | Not shipped yet — Windows .exe is the current build | | Steam Deck (Proton) | Community | Reported working via Proton 9; unsupported | --- ⚠️ The Problem - Hand-producing faceless content doesn't scale — one editor caps you at 1-2 videos a day. - Renting TTS seats + stock + editing suites stacks into hundreds of dollars a month. - Generic AI video tools spit out cookie-cutter motion graphics every channel uses. - Retention is brutal on silent-scroll viewers who never make it past 15 seconds. - Thumbnails and titles eat 30%+ of a creator's actual working time. - Keeping a consistent brand voice across a big catalog is impossible when five tools touch each episode. - Cross-language expansion means re-hiring a narrator every time you open a new market. --- ✅ The Solution | Problem | Solution | |---|---| | Manual editing caps throughput | One-prompt pipeline renders a full finished episode | | Stacked monthly subscriptions | Single local .exe — no per-seat, per-minute, or per-render billing | | Cookie-cutter AI look | Brand Kit + adaptive diffusion trained on your niche style | | First-15-second drop-off | Hook Forge + Retention Rewriter are core, not optional add-ons | | Thumbnail/title bottleneck | Thumbnail Forger + Title Lab draft both automatically | | Brand voice drift across tools | Saved Presets lock voice, tone, and B-roll rules per channel | | Expensive market expansion | Ship to any language market with a voice-track rerun | --- 🏆 Comparison | Aspect | Alternative | This Tool | |---|---|---| | Setup | OAuth into 3+ cloud services | One .exe, extracted folder, no cloud signups | | Cost model | Monthly per-seat subscription | Local, no recurring tool fee | | Script control | Single black-box LLM prompt | Multi-model router with retention rewrite pass | | Voice consistency | Re-hire or re-pick voice per video | Locked Preset voice bank per channel | | Upload prep | Manually assemble captions + thumbnails | Metadata bundle shipped with the render | | Privacy | Script + voice sent to cloud always | Local Whisper, local diffusion, telemetry off by default | | Batch throughput | Manual, one at a time | Staggered N-video render window | --- 📖 FAQ 1. Is this the same as those "AI video" cloud tools? No. It's a Windows desktop .exe you extract and run. Nothing about your scripts, footage, or voice clips has to leave the machine unless you opt into a paid b-roll model and leave telemetry on. 2. Does it really work on Windows 10? Yes — 21H2 or newer, 64-bit. Windows 11 is the primary development target where all modules are enabled. 3. Do I need coding or video editing skills? No. If you can write a paragraph about your niche, you can drive it. The pipeline handles everything from scripting to upload-ready deliverables. 4. Can I use my own face — I want to appear? The tool is designed for faceless channels, but nothing stops you from side-loading webcam footage. Series Mode and the brand kit both accept real-shot clips. 5. Why does the app need internet on first launch? The bundled runtime downloads the Whisper speech model and the diffusion b-roll pack once (4.2 GB). After that launch pulls, offline mode works. 6. Can I build a channel in a language other than English? Yes — 12 narrator languages are bundled, each with voice tuning so multiple episodes in the same language sound consistent. 7. Is anything sent to a server without my consent? Telemetry is off by default. The only outbound calls are the engine updater and any paid model you personally configure for b-roll generation. 8. What happens to unsaved renders if the app crashes? Project Save/Load and crash recovery keep intermediate state — an interrupted episode resumes where the render stalled, at worst a segment back. 9. Does the metadata bundle upload to YouTube automatically? No. It produces description, chapters, tags, thumbnail, and captions as a local folder — you control the actual upload from your own account. --- 🧭 Troubleshooting flow First launch hangs on the model pull → check the connection and free space on the extraction drive. Render starts then dies at 60-70% → most often the CPU/GPU pass choked on a low-VRAM card; switch the encoder. Captions show up but with wrong timing → run the re-sync pass in the timeline panel. Thumbnails export but text is off-center → confirm the brand kit has a thumbnail safe-region set for the current aspect ratio. Everything looks fine but the video is quiet → re-run the loudness normalizer; -14 LUFS is the shipped default. --- 🧾 Closing The whole point of a faceless channel is throughput, and throughput is exactly what the AI faceless YouTube channel generator optimizes. It removes the three things that actually kill faceless channels — clicking, cost per episode, and cloud reliance — and leaves a local render pipeline you can run overnight. Extract, run the .exe, and let the episode count speak for itself.
